stats.note: PSNR sample inflated by random motion-kernel direction; CI worse

analysis.rationale: JPEG confirmed by 0%FP block_boundary=2.1245 (sim jpeg:2 bb 2.02-2.19, error 0-5% on all 5 pairs). Motion blur confirmed over gaussian/lens/glass by PSNR+CI; severity 3 chosen by same-image signal match (gm 0.268/0.293 vs 0.263, slope 1.226/1.171 vs 1.195, FFT aniso 1.87/1.54 vs 1.70). Motion kernel direction is randomized per call (repeat of identical pipeline: PSNR 25.65 vs 20.94 dB), capping PSNR at 24-31 dB, so deterministic steps cannot reach LIKELY; per-step verdicts: jpeg LIKELY, motion UNCERTAIN. NO_NOISE (sigma=1.11; noiseless sim reproduces all noise signals) and NO_GLOBAL. Cross-pair CI 9-10/10 on 4/4 verification pairs.
